name: assess_rwa_evidence
description: Evaluate supplied RWA/tokenized-stock evidence against an explicit policy. Unsigned diagnostic only: caller-supplied facts are not authenticated, and ALLOW does not authorize a trade. Existing pre-trade and authorization checks remain required.

name: get_robinhood_rwa_instrument
description: Resolve a Robinhood Stock Token to Insight committed master data, using share-class FIGI for the underlying and ISO 10383 MIC for its primary market, then cross-check issuer UID, ISIN and contract deployment. Reference/admission evidence only; it never counts toward price quorum or authorizes a trade.

symbol.description: Robinhood Stock Token symbol, e.g. AAPL, NVDA, SPY

verifyOnchain.description: Also collect the existing on-chain issuer-context integrity checks

name: get_robinhood_rwa_context
description: Get Robinhood Stock Token issuer context: official asset identity, trading capabilities, halt state, corporate actions, multiplier-normalized reference price, and optional on-chain ERC-8056 verification. First-party evidence only; it is not an independent oracle and never counts toward oracle quorum or authorizes a trade.

symbol.description: Robinhood Stock Token symbol, e.g. AAPL, NVDA, SPY

verifyOnchain.description: Cross-check the REST multiplier and pause state on Robinhood Chain

name: get_oracle_price
description: Fetch the latest price from a specific oracle provider for an asset.

provider.description: Oracle provider name, e.g. chainlink, redstone, api3

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, BTC/USD

chain.description: Optional blockchain, e.g. ethereum, arbitrum, base

forceRefresh.description: Force refresh from upstream instead of cache

name: get_consensus_price
description: Get the aggregated consensus price for an asset across multiple oracle providers. Useful when you need a robust, manipulation-resistant reference price.

name: get_risk_summary
description: Get a composite risk summary for an asset across selected oracle providers. Includes HHI concentration, volatility, correlation, freshness, manipulation resistance, and shared-dependency risk.

period.description: Analysis period in hours, default 168 (7 days)

name: get_oracle_health
description: Get the ecosystem-wide oracle health report for a specific date (uptime, staleness, and success rates across all providers). Use this for a dated snapshot of overall health. For a single feed by UUID use get_feed_health; to scan current freshness across many feeds use get_feed_freshness.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, defaults to today

name: check_liquidation_risk
description: Check protocol liquidation risk for a specific date. Returns stress-test results based on representative benchmark positions.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, defaults to today

name: compare_oracle_deviation
description: Compare historical price deviations across oracle providers for an asset. Helps identify which providers consistently diverge from consensus.

name: get_stablecoin_peg
description: Check stablecoin peg status. Provide a symbol for a specific stablecoin, or omit it to get all tracked stablecoins.

symbol.description: Stablecoin symbol. Supported: USDC, USDT, DAI, FRAX, LUSD

name: get_protocol_risk_params
description: Get risk parameters for a specific DeFi protocol, including liquidation thresholds, LTV ratios, and collateral factors.

protocol.description: Protocol name or slug, e.g. aave-v3, compound-v3

name: get_symbols
description: List supported asset symbols. Optionally filter by a search query. Use this when you are unsure whether a symbol is supported.

query.description: Optional search query to filter symbols

name: recommend_oracle_setup
description: Recommend oracle provider setup for an asset based on active feeds. Use this to decide which providers to include in price feeds or risk analysis.

symbol.description: Asset symbol to recommend an oracle setup for, e.g. BTC, ETH

name: get_stablecoin_list
description: List all tracked stablecoin symbols.

query.description: Optional search query to filter symbols

name: get_oracle_prices_batch
description: Fetch prices for multiple assets/providers in a single request. Up to 20 queries.

forceRefresh.description: Force refresh from upstream instead of cache

name: get_price_history
description: Get historical price data for an asset from a specific oracle provider over a period (in hours).

forceRefresh.description: Force refresh from upstream instead of cache

name: get_cross_chain_spreads
description: Get pairwise price spreads across chains for a given provider and symbol. Useful for cross-chain arbitrage and risk tracking.

name: get_wrapped_asset_peg
description: Check wrapped asset (e.g. WBTC, wstETH) peg status. Provide a symbol for a specific asset, or omit it to get all tracked wrapped assets.

symbol.description: Wrapped asset symbol. Supported: WBTC, wstETH, cbETH, BTCB, STETH, cbBTC, tBTC

name: get_protocols
description: Get a list of lending protocols with dynamic data (TVL, asset counts, oracle providers used). Optionally filter by name/slug query.

query.description: Optional search query to filter protocols

name: get_protocol_oracle_exposure
description: Analyze oracle provider concentration risk for a specific lending protocol. Shows which providers cover which assets and concentration metrics.

protocol.description: Protocol ID or slug, e.g. aave-v3, compound-v3

name: get_feed_freshness
description: Scan current freshness/staleness across many active feeds, filterable by provider, symbol, or category. Use this to find feeds needing attention right now. For a single feed by UUID use get_feed_health; for a dated ecosystem-wide report use get_oracle_health.

name: get_feeds
description: List oracle feeds from the registry with optional filters (provider, symbol, category, chain, active status). Useful for discovering available feeds and their metadata.

name: get_feed_health
description: Get detailed point-in-time health status for ONE specific oracle feed by its UUID (consecutive failures, last success/failure, status). For ecosystem-wide health by date use get_oracle_health; to scan freshness across many feeds use get_feed_freshness.

name: get_feed_uptime
description: Analyze feed data-delivery reliability over a date range: success rate, hours with data, coverage %, and average snapshots per day per provider+symbol. Use this to assess how completely a feed delivered data over time — distinct from get_feed_health (point-in-time status) and get_latency (speed).

name: get_reputation_rankings
description: Get oracle provider reputation rankings with trend over a period (1-90 days).

name: get_provider_reputation
description: Get detailed reputation metrics for a specific oracle provider, optionally with historical trend.

name: get_daily_report
description: Get the full daily oracle/risk report for a specific date, including liquidation risks, anomalies, and market summary.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, defaults to today

name: get_incidents
description: Get oracle incidents and deviation events within a date range. Filter by provider and minimum severity.

name: get_latency
description: Analyze 15-minute oracle collector latency statistics (min, mean, p50, p90, p95, p99) over a date range, optionally filtered by provider or symbol.

name: get_anomalies
description: Get aggregated oracle anomaly events over a lookback period (1-30 days), including top deviation events and risk impacts.

name: get_correlation
description: Compute pairwise Pearson correlation of oracle provider deviations for an asset over a date range. Helps identify independent vs correlated providers.

name: get_coverage
description: Identify oracle coverage gaps and single-provider-risk symbols (assets served by only one oracle — a concentration risk). Returns breakdowns by provider, chain, and symbol. Use this when assessing where coverage is thin. For ecosystem scale plus top reputable providers, use get_metrics instead.

name: get_metrics
description: Compact ecosystem overview: provider/feed/symbol/chain/category counts plus top providers ranked by reputation score. Use this for a quick scale snapshot or provider ranking. To find coverage gaps and single-provider risk, use get_coverage instead.

name: get_monad_dex_market
description: Get fresh, block-pinned Monad Uniswap V3 WMON/USDC market evidence: spot, 15-minute TWAP, active liquidity, executable quote ladder, and finalized rolling volume. This is a single-venue DEX market source, not an oracle-consensus price.

name: get_hanji_monad_market
description: Get fresh Hanji Monad MON/USDC CLOB context: code-pinned orderbook and fast-quoter proxy identities, proxy implementation identities, L2 spread, displayed depth, and bounded two-sided book-impact estimates. It is read-only venue context, not an oracle-consensus price or executable order quote.

name: get_base_dex_market
description: Get fresh, block-pinned Base Uniswap V3 WETH/USDC market evidence: spot, 30-minute TWAP, active liquidity, and executable quote ladder. This is one DEX venue, not an oracle-consensus price.

name: get_base_dex_venue_integrations
description: Get block-pinned code-identity evidence for reviewed Base DEX deployments: Aerodrome Slipstream, PancakeSwap V3, Curve StableSwap, Maverick V2, QuickSwap V2 and Algebra V4, Uniswap V4, and PancakeSwap Infinity. The response distinguishes currently enabled unsigned-calldata lanes from venues that remain read-only until their pool-specific model, hook/plugin, and tests are reviewed.

venues.description: Optional reviewed Base venues to inspect; defaults to every reviewed venue

name: get_aerodrome_slipstream_market
description: Get fresh, block-pinned market evidence for one allowlisted Aerodrome Slipstream Base pool. The pool’s Factory, QuoterV2, and runtime code identities are re-verified at the quoted block. This is DEX venue context, not an oracle-consensus price.

profileId.description: Reviewed Aerodrome Slipstream pool id; defaults to Base WETH/USDC CL100

name: prepare_aerodrome_slipstream_swap
description: Prepare a user-signable exact-input swap against one allowlisted Base Aerodrome Slipstream pool. The tool takes a reviewed profile id, exact input amount, recipient, short deadline, and slippage bound; then obtains a pinned quote and re-verifies the Factory, QuoterV2, Pool, and Router identities. It returns unsigned approval and swap calldata only. Insight never receives a key, signs, relays, or broadcasts a transaction.

profileId.description: Reviewed Aerodrome Slipstream pool id; defaults to Base WETH/USDC CL100

amountIn.description: Exact WETH input amount; the tool never handles native ETH

recipient.description: USDC recipient encoded into the unsigned router transaction

deadlineUnixSeconds.description: User-selected Unix deadline, no more than 30 minutes ahead

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum shortfall versus the pinned quote, encoded as amountOutMinimum

name: prepare_base_agent_swap_guard
description: Prepare and gate one reviewed Base direct-router swap for an AI agent: Aerodrome Slipstream WETH→USDC CL100 or PancakeSwap V3 USDC→USDT 0.01%. It obtains a fresh pinned quote, re-verifies reviewed contract identities, canonical-decodes the exact approval/swap calldata, validates both agent decision prices against independent oracle consensus, and converts the route quote using the independent destination consensus before applying price-impact/TWAP/slippage/freshness policy. ALLOW returns exact unsigned approval and swap calldata plus a decisionHash; CAUTION or BLOCK returns no calls to sign. It does not route, sign, relay, broadcast, authorize, assess smart-account UserOperations, or accept arbitrary aggregator calldata.

name: get_pancakeswap_v3_market
description: Get fresh, block-pinned market evidence for one allowlisted PancakeSwap V3 Base pool. The Factory, QuoterV2, and Pool runtime identities are re-verified at the quoted block. This is DEX venue context, not an oracle-consensus price.

profileId.description: Reviewed PancakeSwap V3 pool id; defaults to Base USDC/USDT 0.01%

profileId.description: Reviewed PancakeSwap V3 pool id; defaults to Base USDC/USDT 0.01%

profileId.description: Reviewed QuickSwap V2 pair id; defaults to Base USDC/USDT

name: get_solana_dex_route
description: Get fresh Jupiter SOL/USDC exact-input route evidence: quote ladder, price impact, selected AMM route, quote context slot, and finalized Solana RPC witness. It is a route quote, not a simulated or guaranteed swap.

name: get_hyperliquid_perp_market
description: Get fresh Hyperliquid mainnet perpetual-market evidence for a reviewed BTC, ETH, or HYPE market: mark/oracle divergence, funding, open interest, 24-hour notional volume, L2 spread, displayed depth, and two-sided book-impact estimates. It is read-only CLOB context, not an oracle-consensus price or executable exchange quote.

market.description: Reviewed Hyperliquid perpetual market: BTC, ETH, or HYPE. Defaults to BTC.

name: prepare_hyperliquid_perp_order
description: Prepare a reviewed BTC, ETH, or HYPE Hyperliquid perpetual IOC order for LOCAL user/agent-wallet signing. Validates live asset metadata, lot/tick rules, caller notional cap, mark-oracle divergence, and displayed-L2 fill/impact bounds. Returns an unsigned, short-expiry exchange envelope only when every gate passes. Insight never creates a nonce, receives a key, signs, or submits an order.

name: verify_hyperliquid_perp_execution
description: Read and verify the public Hyperliquid status and bounded fill history for one user-signed reviewed BTC, ETH, or HYPE perp order. Compares the returned order and fills to the expected client-order-id intent. This is an observed Info-API record, not an Insight signature, a wallet authorization, or a trade submission.

name: base_lending_guard
description: Read-only Base lending pre-signing gate for Aave V3, an exact Morpho Blue market, Compound V3 USDC Comet, or reviewed Moonwell markets. Separately evaluates collateral and loan oracle integrity, checks caller-declared post-action LTV against live protocol parameters, and returns ALLOW / CAUTION / BLOCK. It never signs, broadcasts, or authorizes a transaction; bind a successful decision to an exact user-authorized transaction separately.

name: base_lending_guard_exact_call
description: Create portable Insight risk evidence for one exact unsigned direct Aave V3, Morpho Blue, Compound V3, or reviewed Moonwell Base supply/borrow call. It verifies target, selector, token or market binding, sender, nonce and zero value, then returns a short-lived EIP-712 decision when Insight signing is configured. It never authorizes, signs, or broadcasts the transaction; bind an ALLOW through PriorSeal or another user-authorization system.

name: monad_lending_guard
description: Read-only Monad lending pre-signing gate for direct Aave V3 or an exact Morpho Blue market. Separately evaluates collateral and loan oracle integrity, checks caller-declared post-action LTV against live protocol parameters, and returns ALLOW / CAUTION / BLOCK. It never signs, broadcasts, or authorizes a transaction; bind a successful decision to an exact user-authorized transaction separately.

name: monad_lending_guard_exact_call
description: Create portable Insight risk evidence for one exact unsigned direct Aave V3 Monad or Morpho Blue Monad supply/borrow call. It verifies target, selector, token or market binding, sender, nonce and zero value, then returns a short-lived EIP-712 decision when Insight signing is configured. It never authorizes, signs, or broadcasts the transaction; bind an ALLOW through PriorSeal or another user-authorization system.

name: multichain_evm_lending_guard
description: Read-only lending pre-signing gate for reviewed Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, and BNB Chain deployments: Aave V3, Venus Core, Compound V3, Dolomite, Morpho Blue, Lista Moolah, Euler v2, and Fluid T1. Euler borrowing is accepted only as the reviewed four-step EVC batch; Dolomite only as one sender-owned account with one direct deposit or borrow; Fluid T1 only as collateral-only supply into a factory-authenticated vault. The tool checks caller-declared post-action values against live protocol state and independent oracle evidence, then returns ALLOW / CAUTION / BLOCK. It never signs, broadcasts, or authorizes a transaction.

name: multichain_evm_lending_guard_exact_call
description: Create portable Insight evidence for one exact unsigned direct reviewed EVM lending call on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, or BNB Chain. It binds target, calldata, sender, nonce, value, protocol market, and short-lived Insight signature when configured. It never authorizes, signs, relays, or broadcasts the transaction; use PriorSeal for user authorization.

name: solana_lending_guard
description: Create portable Insight risk evidence for exactly one unsigned direct Kamino Lend, Marginfi v2, Jupiter Lend Earn deposit, or Save Lend reserve-liquidity deposit instruction on Solana mainnet. Save additionally verifies the submitted asset mint against the live source SPL token account. It accepts no transaction authority, verifies reviewed program-owned accounts, simulates the full unsigned message, checks both assets’ oracle evidence, and returns ALLOW / CAUTION / BLOCK. An ALLOW still needs a separately user-authorized PriorSeal binding before execution.

name: loopscale_vault_deposit
description: Build a single Solana mainnet Loopscale lending-vault deposit with Loopscale’s official production API, verify the live vault and principal mint, resolve every address lookup table, simulate the exact unsigned message, check oracle evidence, and return short-lived Insight evidence for PriorSeal. It does not sign, authorize, or broadcast. Deposit bundles requiring preliminary transactions are rejected rather than partially attested.

name: check_position_safety
description: Check the safety of a DeFi lending position against oracle deviation stress tests. Supports multi-asset or single-asset positions.

name: pre_trade_safety_check
description: Pre-trade decision-input integrity checkpoint for AI agents. Call this BEFORE executing any on-chain swap/borrow/lend/liquidation/repay to verify that the price the action relies on can be trusted. First assessment domain: oracle risk — aggregates cross-oracle consensus prices, per-provider deviation, data freshness, stablecoin peg status, and reputation into a single verdict. An optional decisionInput object adds a separate Chainlink/CEX/DEX input-sufficiency assessment against the caller-supplied venue quote and explicit limits, with an independently verifiable EIP-712 signature when signing is enabled; it never changes the verdict. Verdicts are PASS / CAUTION / DANGER / BLOCK. AI agents MUST NOT execute trades when the verdict is DANGER or BLOCK. Also returns a recommended maximum position size. A PASS is not principal authorization or a guarantee of price correctness or economic safety.

asset.description: Asset symbol being traded, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDC

chainId.description: Chain ID where the trade executes, e.g. 1=Ethereum, 42161=Arbitrum, 8453=Base. Use 0 for chain-agnostic.

targetProviders.description: Optional: restrict the check to specific oracle providers

name: oracle_watch
description: Ongoing cross-oracle risk signal for an asset: current consensus deviation, agreement, quorum, outliers and staleness condensed into a NORMAL / CAUTION / DANGER verdict with a proceed / proceed_with_caution / halt recommendation. Agents should gate long-running strategies (yield, keeper, portfolio) on this signal, not just one-off trades. Pair it with pre_trade_safety_check for the decision moment.

name: oracle_watch_history
description: Retrospective Oracle Watch trend for an asset: verdict stability, degraded-time ratio, worst deviation and mean credibility over the last N days, plus the recent series. Use it to judge whether a feed has been dependable, not just whether it is healthy this instant. History is guaranteed only for the committed universe (ETH/BTC/USDC/USDT x ethereum/arbitrum/base); other pairs return a live point signal from oracle_watch but no curve.

interval.description: Aggregation grain: 30min, hourly, or daily. Default hourly; 8-30d raw requests roll up hourly and windows over 30d roll up daily

name: execution_receipt
description: Issue signed execution-price evidence comparing an observed fill with the oracle-assessed quote and signed slippage band. Provide the pre-trade fields (preTradeUid, requestHash, asset ids, chain, oracle gate counts) plus the settlement txHash. Insight collects the on-chain fill, signs a receipt paired to the pre-trade via preTradeUid + requestHash, and returns a FAITHFUL / DEVIATED / NOT_EXECUTED / UNDETERMINED verdict. This reports supported price/fill fidelity, not principal authorization or overall transaction safety. Pair it with pre_trade_safety_check and oracle_watch.

preTradeUid.description: UID of the paired pre-trade attestation

requestHash.description: Canonical request commitment from the pre-trade attestation

sourceAssetId.description: CAIP-19 id of the asset sold

destinationAssetId.description: CAIP-19 id of the asset bought

subjectChainId.description: Chain id the pre-trade was scoped to

settlementChainId.description: Chain id the transaction settled on

participantCount.description: Oracle providers the agent gated on

sourceGroupCount.description: Distinct non-derived operator groups the agent gated on

preTradeSignedAt.description: Unix seconds the pre-trade was signed

quotedPrice.description: Target price, same convention as executedPrice (e.g. dest per source)

maxSlippageBps.description: Pre-committed platform bound; currently fixed at 50 bps

taker.description: Address whose balances define the trade; defaults to tx sender

name: execution_preflight
description: Action-facing, chain-neutral data-sufficiency gate for an intended swap, borrow, lend, liquidation, or repay. It composes Insight’s strict multi-oracle pre-trade assessment with an optional fresh venue-quote assessment into ALLOW / CAUTION / BLOCK, lists the exact missing evidence, and returns the underlying signed assessment when available. It evaluates data sufficiency only — never contract safety, custody, profitability, or transaction execution. Monad is a first-class profile using on-chain Pyth Core evidence; set targetProviders to ["pyth"] for a low-latency native snapshot, which remains CAUTION under the strict quorum policy until independent evidence is present. Other supported chains use their configured oracle adapters.

asset.description: Asset symbol being traded, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDC

chainId.description: Chain ID where the trade executes, e.g. 1=Ethereum, 42161=Arbitrum, 8453=Base. Use 0 for chain-agnostic.

targetProviders.description: Optional: restrict the check to specific oracle providers

destinationAsset.description: Optional destination asset for the intended route

protocolId.description: Optional protocol identifier for lending actions

tokenAddress.description: Optional 20-byte EVM token address for advisory token-security evidence

decisionInput.description: Optional fresh venue quote and explicit limits. This evidence is required for an ALLOW result; without it a healthy oracle result remains CAUTION.

reviewedUniswapV3.description: Optional strict reviewed-pool lane. Admits Monad MON/WMON→USDC and Base ETH/WETH→USDC through Uniswap V3, plus Base USDC→USDT through PancakeSwap V3; only the reviewed forward directions are admitted and all other routes fail closed.

amountIn.description: Exact source-token amount for the reviewed concentrated-liquidity quote

reviewedAerodromeSlipstream.description: Optional strict reviewed-pool lane. Only WETH/USDC on Base through the reviewed Aerodrome Slipstream CL100 pool is admitted; unsupported routes fail closed.

amountIn.description: Exact WETH amount for the reviewed Base Aerodrome Slipstream WETH/USDC CL100 quote

name: agent_begin_trade
description: Obtain oracle assessment evidence for a swap/DeFi intent BEFORE trading. Insight runs the oracle safety check and, if the verdict is PASS/CAUTION, returns a machine-readable "execution certification handle": preTradeUid, requestHash, CAIP-19 asset ids, the certified price (destination per source) and maxSlippageBps, plus a required operation-input check for both asset legs and a fresh Uniswap V3 on-chain route quote cross-checked by two Ethereum RPCs. If either input assessment is not SUFFICIENT, either route quote is stale or outside policy, or either oracle gate blocks, no execution handle is issued. The assessments are independently EIP-712 signed and linked to the receipt through both pre-trade UIDs. participant/source-group counts and the pre-trade signing time. Execute the trade with YOUR wallet, then call execution_receipt with this handle + txHash to obtain the signed, verifiable Execution Receipt. If the verdict is DANGER or BLOCK this tool refuses (do not trade). This is oracle assessment evidence, not principal authorization — pair it with execution_receipt.

asset.description: Source asset symbol being sold, e.g. ETH, USDC

destinationAsset.description: Destination asset symbol being bought, e.g. USDC, ETH

chainId.description: Chain ID where the trade executes, e.g. 1=Ethereum, 42161=Arbitrum, 8453=Base

maxSlippageBps.description: Current pre-committed execution tolerance; custom values are rejected

targetProviders.description: Optional: restrict the check to specific oracle providers

protocolId.description: Optional lending protocol id (lending actions only)

sourceGroupCount.description: Distinct non-derived operator groups; defaults to participantCount

routeQuotePrice.description: Caller-reported destination-per-source route quote, compared with Insight's on-chain quote

routeQuoteObservedAt.description: Timezone-qualified caller quote timestamp; checked for freshness as an additional condition

decisionInput.description: Required operation-input gate for both assets and the caller-reported route quote. Insight also obtains an exact-notional Uniswap V3 quote on Ethereum mainnet, sized from a fresh Chainlink price and cross-checked by two RPCs at one block. No execution handle is issued unless both signed assessments pass and the on-chain quote, caller quote, and oracle cross-rate satisfy the 50 bps-capped policy. Supported pairs are ETH/WETH, USDC, and WBTC on Ethereum; other routes fail closed.

name: verify_execution_pair
description: Verify that a pre-trade oracle-safety attestation and an Execution Receipt describe the same assessed trade and that the certify → execute → prove loop closed. Returns pairedValid, the closed-loop status (CLOSED_FAITHFUL / CLOSED_DEVIATED / CLOSED_NOT_EXECUTED / CLOSED_UNDETERMINED, PRICE_-prefixed on v3 receipts whose signed verdict is priceExecutionStatus, or PAIR_INVALID), and the binding assertions (preTradeUid, requestHash, destination gate + preTradeUidsHash on v3, chain, asset). On a v3 receipt that commits to a destination gate, pass destinationPreTradeAttestation or the pair cannot close. This checks assessment/price-evidence binding; it does not establish principal authorization, price correctness, or economic safety. Pair it with agent_begin_trade and execution_receipt.

preTradeAttestation.description: The pre-trade oracle-safety attestation the agent gated on.

executionReceipt.description: The Execution Receipt to check against the pre-trade attestation.
